purpose: Reusable, diagnosis-optional communication support cards for BridgeTranslate implementations.
rules: Display the plain label first and the explanatory label in brackets.
Treat bracketed labels as optional navigation aids, not diagnoses.
Allow multiple selections and a complete skip.
Never require speech, a diagnosis, or disclosure of disability.
Preserve the user's selected communication method throughout the crossing.

options.example: I may explain several linked things before the main point becomes visible.

options.plain_label: I know what I mean but cannot find the word
options.example: I may describe a person, object or role by its function, story or relationship.

options.plain_label: My information comes out in a different order
options.example: Please organise it without removing useful context.

options.plain_label: I understand complex ideas but forms confuse me
options.example: I may understand the subject while not understanding what the question expects.

options.plain_label: I need time before the full explanation arrives
options.example: Important context may become available after I have started answering.

options.plain_label: I understand better through examples, pictures or practical systems
options.example: Abstract wording may need a real example or structural map.

options.plain_label: Feelings are hard to identify or name
options.example: I may know something matters before I can label the emotion.

options.plain_label: Body signals are hard to identify or explain
options.example: I may notice a change in function before I can describe the sensation.

options.plain_label: Stress changes how well I can communicate
options.example: I may lose words, speech, memory or sequencing when overloaded.
Do not require a voice response or telephone conversation.

options.plain_label: My speech may stop or become unreliable
options.example: Writing may remain available when speaking is not.

options.plain_label: I use a communication aid or another person to support communication
options.example: Accept typed, selected, symbol-based or supported input as my own communication.
Let me dictate naturally and correct the written result afterwards.
Keep every stage available without voice input.
Use short sections, clear spacing and optional explanations.

options.plain_label: English is not my first or strongest language
options.example: Use clear English and avoid unnecessary idioms.

options.plain_label: I understand the words but not what the system wants
options.example: Explain the function of the question before asking me to answer it.
Help me identify which support patterns fit without requiring a label.
